note: Carter County KY has no county zoning layer found in ArcGIS search, Kentucky Geography Network, or the county's assessor/PVA pages (parcel viewer only). City of Grayson publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (Zoning-Map.pdf) with no queryable service. City of Olive Hill has zoning in its code of ordinances (Title 17) as text, with no GIS layer found. No public ArcGIS REST zoning district layer exists for the county or its cities.
